column2: Now... have you found an answer of your own!?
Destroy this entire $$世界$$, become the new $$ゴッド$$, and bring $$ご主人様$$ back to life!
Save this $$世界$$ from collapse, become $$ハ・サタン$$, kill your companions, and bring $$ご主人様$$ back to life!
What do you mean, you refuse both of those!?
You refuse to destroy this $$世界$$ or sacrifice your companions and $$ご主人様$$, so you will take your own life!!
Save this $$世界$$ from collapse and protect your other companions by giving up on saving $$ご主人様$$!
And what do you intend to do after giving up!?
Find a new $$ご主人様$$ and live an ordinary life from now on!
Defeat the $$教皇$$ and create a $$世界$$ where black $$羽$$ and white $$羽$$ are $$平等$$!
